name: Parallel Minor7 Stabs
desc: Descending Am7-Gm7-Fm7-Em7 parallel-motion sawtooth stabs with a slow filter sweep — the moody liquid/cinematic chord bed from the jungle section.

code.full: chord("<Am7 Gm7 Fm7 Em7>/2").dict("ireal").voicing().add(note(${root})).struct("[x ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ x ~]").s("sawtooth").add(note("0,0.08,-0.06")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.35, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(${res}).attack(.01).release(.8).gain(${gain}).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(24)).room(.55).roomsize(5).delay(.2).delaytime(.5).delayfeedback(.25).every(8, x => x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
